capabilities: Render embedded images as polaroid frames with drop shadows
Generate handwritten captions from alt text or filename
Apply slight random rotation to embedded images
Lift and straighten frames on hover
Add push-pin decoration on embedded notes
extras: Bundles the Caveat font under the SIL OFL license; a font license file is included.
problem: Obsidian renders embedded images as plain rectangles with no visual styling, so note writers who want scrapbook-like image presentation must hand-write CSS.
summary: Polaroid-style frame renderer that styles embedded images with drop shadows, handwritten captions, random rotation and hover effects.
